# Remote artwork

Remote follows the Pixel Brewery portfolio series used by Cursor: a warm studio
background, ivory ceramic, frosted glass and a black wordmark. Its distinct
accent is indigo (`#5B4BDB`); petrol remains reserved for Cursor.

The interlocking-link mark represents a paired connection. The portfolio card
shows a desktop and phone joined by that connection. The transparent app icon
and panoramic website hero derive from the same approved composition.

The artwork was generated with ImageGen. `project-card.json` records the
dimensions, alternative text and provenance. The WebP exports are delivery
assets; original generated images remain in the creator's private generation
library and are not runtime dependencies.
